messages.subject: Changing thickness of individual edges
parts:
Hi y'all,

I'm trying to change the thickness of the branches in a phylogeny so that the branches in my clades of interest are thicker than those that are not. I've been able to get branches of multiple thicknesses, but unable to find a way to order my input dataframe so that the branches I want are the thickness I want. Any help is appreciated!

# generate dataframe of sizes for each edge
d2 <-
  data.frame(edge=0:(length(tree_pruned$edge.length+1)), size=0.05) %>%
  mutate(size = replace(size, edge %in% c(15:73, 804:860, 1355:1398, 1757:1803), 0.3))

# order dataframe, I've tried both of the methods below with no success
d2 <-
  d2[
  order( tree_pruned$edge[,1], tree_pruned$edge[,2] ),
]

d2 <- d2[ tree_pruned$edge[,2], ]

# generate initial tree
circ <-
  ggtree(tree_pruned, ladderize = T, layout = "circular", aes(size=d2$size), branch.length = "none") %<+% d + aes(color=I(color)) +
scale_color_manual(values=c("black", "#C0C0C0")) +
scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.05, 0.3))

# scale clades
  p1 <-  scaleClade(circ, node=1755, scale=7, vertical_only = T)
  p2 <-  scaleClade(p1, node=2027, scale=7, vertical_only = T)
  p3 <-  scaleClade(p2, node=1358, scale=7, vertical_only = T)
  p4 <-  scaleClade(p3, node=2226, scale=7, vertical_only = T)

# phylogeny
 
p6 +
 geom_strip(taxa1 = 401, taxa2 = 421, label = "Bacteroidota", offset.text = 1) +
 geom_strip(taxa1 = 691, taxa2 = 674, label = "Planctomycetota", offset.text = 3, hjust = 0.5) +
    geom_strip(taxa1 = 11, taxa2 = 15, label = "Proteobacteria", offset.text = 25) +
    geom_strip(taxa1 = 878, taxa2 = 898, label = "Patescibacteria", offset.text = 4, hjust = 0.5)


Thanks!
